title: Age Gate Review Queue
description: Review upstream releases held back for being younger than a repository's minimum age.
accessDenied: The age gate review queue requires administrator access.
reopenUnsupported: This server does not support reopening a decided review, so approved and rejected reviews cannot be changed here. Reviews that are still pending can be approved or rejected as usual.
selectStatusPrompt: Select at least one status to list reviews.
loadFailed: Couldn't load the age gate queue
noReleases: No releases in the age gate queue.
noReleasesFor: No {statuses} releases in the age gate queue.
describeApprove: This releases the version to any client that requests it. The review can be reopened later to withhold it again.
describeReject: The version stays withheld and clients requesting it keep getting the gate response.
describeReturn: This reverses the recorded {from} decision and puts the version back behind the gate until someone decides it again.
describeChange: This reverses the recorded {from} decision and marks the review {to} instead, in a single step.
confirmRelease: Confirm you mean to release {name}@{version} into the estate.
reasonHelpRequired: Required. Reversing a recorded decision needs a reason for the audit log.
reasonHelpOptional: Recorded in the audit log with this decision.
